## Introduction

This report uses the *tidyverse* (meta-)package along
with the **SAFI** **_dataset_**.
<!-- comment 
multiple lines
-->

The variables include:

- village
- interview_date
  + Date of the interview
- no_membrs

My favourites are:

1. interview_date
2. no_membrs
3. rooms

## Results

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
interviews %>%
  filter(!is.na(memb_assoc)) %>%
  group_by(village, memb_assoc) %>%
  summarise(mean_no_membrs = mean(no_membrs)) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

The number of members in the first row is `r interviews$no_membrs[1]`

```{r}
#| echo: false
interviews_plotting %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = respondent_wall_type, fill = village)) +
    geom_bar()
```
